propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar and .github/module-size-limit.txt file reading must be removed from git_metrics and registry
A new _analyzer_spec adapter must invoke scc_loc.analyze and wire LOC payload to size metric functions with uniform (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) signature
Context in _commands/metrics.py must be extended to carry scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction from [code_health] config
module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count functions must correctly compute cap/near-cap counts with inclusive boundaries and return None when size_cap is unconfigured
The oversized_module_count seed stub must be removed and cap_change_events must be deregistered; module_size_trend stub must remain and return Unavailable
Analyzer-derived specs must carry source=structural and lens=code_health provenance; foreign repos without scc must return Unavailable instead of fabricated zeros
